name: Volumetric Super-Resolution via Plane Upscaling
definition: A method to super-resolve 3D scenes by applying a 2D image super-resolution network $F$ directly to the learned 2D feature planes of the scene representation, rather than upscaling rendered images.
summary: Volumetric Super-Resolution via Plane Upscaling enhances 3D scenes by applying 2D super-resolution networks directly to learned feature planes, rather than upscaling rendered images.
